markdown.description: The whole page: --- frontmatter (id, type, template, title, aliases, summary, tags, cites, refs, related, updated_at, last_verified, status, sensitivity, as_of, performable, submission) --- then the body. The id (dom-<slug> or rb-<slug>) and type place it at knowledge/domain/<id>.md or knowledge/runbooks/<id>.md; an existing page with that id is replaced.
